# Neyvro Agent Skills

Portable, on-demand skills for Neyvro-compatible AI agents.

## Skills
- [account-research](account-research/SKILL.md): Activate when researching a specific company or person before an authorized GTM decision, draft, or investigation.
- [buyer-matching](buyer-matching/SKILL.md): Activate when matching a target account or problem to buyer roles using authorized company and contact evidence.
- [buying-windows](buying-windows/SKILL.md): Activate when assessing whether dated company changes create a timely, evidence-backed opportunity to investigate or propose outreach.
- [cold-email-writing](cold-email-writing/SKILL.md): Activate when drafting or reviewing a personalized cold email or short sequence from authorized evidence.
- [company-changes](company-changes/SKILL.md): Activate when detecting, explaining, or reviewing material changes in a target company's business context.
- [content-marketing-engine](content-marketing-engine/SKILL.md): Activate when planning buyer-question content, repurposing, distribution, or editorial measurement.
- [continuous-investigation](continuous-investigation/SKILL.md): Activate when creating, monitoring, reviewing, assigning, or correcting a bounded Neyvro investigation.
- [digital-twins](digital-twins/SKILL.md): Activate when building or reviewing an evidence-backed, time-aware projection of a company, buyer, or opportunity.
- [discovery-and-qualification](discovery-and-qualification/SKILL.md): Activate when evaluating whether a company or contact is a qualified opportunity and preparing discovery questions.
- [email-deliverability](email-deliverability/SKILL.md): Activate when assessing sending-domain readiness, authentication, reputation, pacing, bounce, or complaint risk.
- [evidence](evidence/SKILL.md): Activate when collecting, viewing, evaluating, correcting, or citing source-attributed evidence for Neyvro intelligence.
- [generative-engine-optimization](generative-engine-optimization/SKILL.md): Activate when assessing or planning how a site or brand can be retrieved, quoted, and cited by AI answer engines.
- [gtm-automation-with-chronos](gtm-automation-with-chronos/SKILL.md): Activate when a user asks to turn GTM planning into external execution through an authorized MCP or provider.
- [gtm-strategy](gtm-strategy/SKILL.md): Activate when selecting, reviewing, or refining a product's go-to-market motion, acquisition channels, or 30/60/90-day execution plan.
- [ideal-customer-profile](ideal-customer-profile/SKILL.md): Activate when defining, refining, scoring, or reviewing an ideal customer profile, buyer roles, triggers, or anti-ICP.
- [lead-sourcing-and-enrichment](lead-sourcing-and-enrichment/SKILL.md): Activate when finding or enriching ICP-fit companies and contacts with verified, source-labeled data.
- [linkedin-outreach](linkedin-outreach/SKILL.md): Activate when planning or reviewing compliant LinkedIn prospecting and relationship outreach.
- [multichannel-sequences](multichannel-sequences/SKILL.md): Activate when designing, reviewing, or operating a multi-step outreach cadence with explicit branch and stop logic.
- [negative-evidence](negative-evidence/SKILL.md): Activate when recording, evaluating, or explaining disconfirming evidence, missing signals, or reasons not to act.
- [outbound-metrics-and-benchmarks](outbound-metrics-and-benchmarks/SKILL.md): Activate when measuring outreach funnels, setting denominators, comparing benchmarks, or diagnosing campaign health.
- [outreach-personalization](outreach-personalization/SKILL.md): Activate when converting verified company or buyer evidence into relevant, non-creepy outreach personalization.
- [positioning-and-messaging](positioning-and-messaging/SKILL.md): Activate when translating a product's differentiated value into positioning, message houses, or evidence-backed outreach angles.
- [predictive-problems](predictive-problems/SKILL.md): Activate when identifying or reviewing likely future business problems from current evidence and patterns.
- [reply-handling-and-objections](reply-handling-and-objections/SKILL.md): Activate when classifying a prospect reply, drafting a response, or deciding whether follow-up must stop.
- [revenue-attribution](revenue-attribution/SKILL.md): Activate when linking evidence and approved GTM actions to pipeline or revenue outcomes with explicit attribution limits.
- [seo-fundamentals](seo-fundamentals/SKILL.md): Activate when auditing or planning technical, on-page, content, or authority improvements for a website.

## Loading

Use metadata discovery first, then load one exact `SKILL.md`; do not inject the whole bundle into every request.
